name: br_multicast_filter
description: Border Router multicast filtering per spec §6.3.4. BR MUST NOT forward mesh multicasts to internet or vice versa.

vectors.name: mesh_to_internet_unicast_forward
vectors.description: Unicast from mesh to internet: forward normally.

vectors.name: mesh_to_internet_multicast_drop
vectors.description: Multicast from mesh to internet: MUST drop.

vectors.name: internet_to_mesh_unicast_forward
vectors.description: Unicast from internet to mesh: forward normally.

vectors.name: internet_to_mesh_multicast_drop
vectors.description: Multicast from internet to mesh: MUST drop (unless explicit config).

vectors.name: mesh_internal_multicast_relay
vectors.description: Multicast within mesh (not crossing BR): relay per normal rules.

vectors.name: ff0e_global_multicast_drop
vectors.description: Global multicast (ff0e::) from mesh: drop at BR.
